# Veritas Hospitality Advisors

Veritas Hospitality Advisors is a profit-focused hospitality consulting and independent hotel owner advisory firm in India. Founded by Vaishakh Surendran, Veritas works exclusively for independent hotel and resort owners — reviewing commercial performance, operational governance, and owner reporting. Veritas has no relationship with hotel management companies, brands, or operators.

## Founder

Vaishakh Surendran is the founder and principal advisor. He has more than 25 years of hospitality experience, including General Manager roles since 2015, across India, the Maldives, Kuwait, and the USA, having served under Accor, Wyndham, ITC, and Taj. He was named Best General Manager in Odisha 2024–25, received the IGBC Green Crusader designation (World Earth Day 2025), was awarded CMO Asia's Most Influential General Managers recognition (2025), and won the Odisha Best Employer Award 2025. He holds a Diploma in Hospitality Management from Institut Hôtelier César Ritz, Switzerland (2001).

## What Veritas Does

- Independent review of hotel commercial performance for owners
- Owner-side oversight of OTA strategy and distribution costs
- Assessment of management reporting and accountability
- Revenue management audit and benchmarking
- Operational governance review
- Sustainability advisory including IGBC Green Building certification pathway

## Current Client

Sanskreti The Heritage — eco-island heritage resort, Kallanchery Island, North Kumbalanghi, Kochi, Kerala. Vembanad backwaters property with heritage rooms, grand villas, and tree-house villa. Restaurant: The Lilly's; Spa: Parampara (Ayurveda, opening soon). Website: https://www.sanskretitheheritage.com/
